AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

19. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

21. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

----
